def sort_list(lst):
    # Create a copy to avoid modifying the original list
    lst = list(lst)
    for i in range(1, len(lst)):
        key = lst[i]
        j = i - 1
        # Shift elements greater than key to the right
        while j >= 0 and key < lst[j]:
            lst[j + 1] = lst[j]
            j -= 1
        lst[j + 1] = key
    return lst
